study type: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials and observational studies
outcome: completion of postpartum oral glucose tolerance testing (OGTT)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 1,701 patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus or gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) receiving either diabetes group prenatal care or individual prenatal care.
finding: Patients with diabetes receiving group prenatal care had similar rates of preterm birth, LGA, and most other pregnancy outcomes compared to individual care, but were significantly more likely to receive postpartum LARC and complete postpartum OGTT (for GDM patients).
mod_finding: Rates of cesarean delivery were similar between patients receiving diabetes group prenatal care and those receiving individual care.
birth_weight: Birth weight at or above the 90th percentile (for LGA)
gest_age: Before 37 weeks of gestation (for preterm birth)
